## 0. Setup
```{r setup, message=FALSE}
# ---- Clear the environment ----
rm(list=ls())

# ---- Load libraries ----
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggh4x)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(rstatix)
library(indicspecies)

# ---- File paths ----
current_path <- dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
input_path   <- file.path(current_path, "../data/processed/s18_microbial/otu_tables")
output_path  <- file.path(current_path, "../output/disturbance_response")


# ---- Plot settings ----
source(file.path(current_path, "plotting_aesthetics.R")) # Loads theme_wali()
```

## 1. Load & tidy phyloseq data
```{r}
# ---- Load normalized otu tables ----
abund_m <- data.matrix(
  read.csv(file.path(input_path,"s18_otu_qc_relabund_table.csv"), row.names = 1) # Count table
  )
tax_m <- as.matrix(
  read.csv(file.path(input_path,"s18_otu_qc_tax_table.csv"),   row.names = 1) # Taxonomy table
  )
meta <- read.csv(file.path(input_path,"s18_otu_qc_sample_data.csv"), row.names = 1) # Sample data

# ---- Create phyloseq object ----
ps_rel <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(abund_m, taxa_are_rows = T), 
  tax_table(tax_m),
  sample_data(meta))
ps_rel

# ---- Variable lists ----
dm     <- c("09 Jul","16 Jul","23 Jul","30 Jul","06 Aug")
stage  <- c("Pre","Storm","Post")
stage2 <- c("Pre","Storm", "Post1w", "Post2w")
site   <- c("P1","P2","P3","P4","P5","P6","P7","P8","P9","P10","OM2")
region <- c("Kahawai","Mauka","Makai")
pchem  <- c("S_Temp_C","S_Salinity_ppt","S_DO_mgL","S_pH","Turb_FAU") # physicochemical variable column names
nuts   <- c("NO3_uM","NO2_uM","NH3_uM","PO4_uM","SiO2_uM") # Nutrient variable column names

# ---- Format levels ----
ps_rel@sam_data$DM     <- factor(ps_rel@sam_data$DM, levels = dm)
ps_rel@sam_data$Stage  <- factor(ps_rel@sam_data$Stage, levels = stage)
ps_rel@sam_data$Stage2 <- factor(ps_rel@sam_data$Stage2, levels = stage2)
ps_rel@sam_data$Site   <- factor(ps_rel@sam_data$Site, levels = site)
ps_rel@sam_data$Region <- factor(ps_rel@sam_data$Region, levels = region)
```

## Assign OTU fate classifications
```{r}
# ---- Shared constants ----
date_levels <- c("09 Jul", "16 Jul", "23 Jul", "30 Jul", "06 Aug")
fate_order  <- c("Persistent baseline", "Recovered", "Storm-displaced",        # cool / pre-existing
                 "Storm-introduced", "Storm-transient", "Post-storm arrival")   # warm / novel
fate_cols   <- c("Persistent baseline" = "grey50", "Recovered"          = "#2166AC",
                 "Storm-displaced"     = "#9CC7E0", "Storm-introduced"   = "#B2182B",
                 "Storm-transient"     = "#EF8A62", "Post-storm arrival" = "#FDDBC7")
phase_map <- c(`09 Jul` = "pre",  `16 Jul` = "pre",
               `23 Jul` = "storm",
               `30 Jul` = "post", `06 Aug` = "post")

# OTU table + per-sample phase
otu <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_rel))
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_rel)) otu <- as.data.frame(t(otu))

samp <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_rel))
samp$Phase <- phase_map[as.character(samp$DM)]

# Presence/absence per phase
phases <- c("pre", "storm", "post")
otu_presence <- sapply(phases, function(ph) {
  in_phase <- rownames(samp)[samp$Phase == ph]
  rowSums(otu[, in_phase, drop = FALSE] > 0) > 0
})
colnames(otu_presence) <- phases

# ---- Classify fate ----
pre <- otu_presence[, "pre"]; storm <- otu_presence[, "storm"]; post <- otu_presence[, "post"]
fate <- case_when(
   pre &  storm &  post ~ "Persistent baseline",
   pre & !storm &  post ~ "Recovered",
   pre & !post          ~ "Storm-displaced",      # pre-only and pre+storm both land here
  !pre &  storm &  post ~ "Storm-introduced",
  !pre &  storm & !post ~ "Storm-transient",
  !pre & !storm &  post ~ "Post-storm arrival",
  TRUE                  ~ "Other"
)
names(fate) <- rownames(otu)

# Save fate
write.csv(data.frame(OTU_ID = names(fate), Fate = unname(fate)),
          file.path(output_path, "otu_fates.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Diagnostics
cat("OTU fate classification:\n"); print(table(fate))
cat("\nSummed mean relative abundance by fate (%):\n")
print(round(sort(tapply(rowMeans(otu), fate, sum), decreasing = TRUE) * 100, 2))

# Long table: OTU × sample, with fate and date
otu_long <- otu %>%
  rownames_to_column("OTU") %>%
  mutate(Fate = fate[OTU]) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(OTU, Fate), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "RelAbund") %>%
  left_join(rownames_to_column(samp, "Sample") %>% select(Sample, DM), by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(DM = factor(DM, levels = date_levels))

# Abundance share by fate × date
fate_by_date <- otu_long %>%
  group_by(DM, Fate) %>%
  summarise(TotalAbund = sum(RelAbund), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(PropAbund = TotalAbund / sum(TotalAbund) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---- Summary table ----
fate_totals <- as.data.frame(table(fate), responseName = "Total_OTUs") %>% rename(Fate = fate)

otu_counts <- otu_long %>%
  filter(RelAbund > 0) %>%
  group_by(DM, Fate) %>%
  summarise(n_OTUs = n_distinct(OTU), .groups = "drop")

fate_table <- fate_by_date %>%
  left_join(otu_counts, by = c("DM", "Fate")) %>%
  mutate(n_OTUs = replace_na(n_OTUs, 0),
         Cell = if_else(n_OTUs == 0, "—", paste0(round(PropAbund, 1), "% (", n_OTUs, ")"))) %>%
  select(DM, Fate, Cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = DM, values_from = Cell) %>%
  left_join(fate_totals, by = "Fate") %>%
  relocate(Fate, Total_OTUs) %>%
  arrange(factor(Fate, levels = fate_order))

totals_row <- otu_counts %>%
  group_by(DM) %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(n_OTUs), .groups = "drop") %>%
  transmute(DM, Cell = as.character(Total)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = DM, values_from = Cell) %>%
  mutate(Fate = "Total detected OTUs", Total_OTUs = sum(fate_totals$Total_OTUs)) %>%
  relocate(Fate, Total_OTUs)

(fate_table <- bind_rows(fate_table, totals_row))
write.csv(fate_table, file.path(output_path, "s18_otu_fates_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# ---- Stacked bar: fate composition by date ----
(p_fate_bar <- ggplot(fate_by_date %>% mutate(Fate = factor(Fate, levels = rev(fate_order))),
                      aes(x = DM, y = PropAbund, fill = Fate)) +
   annotate("rect", xmin = 2.5, xmax = 3.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#dfdfdf") +  # storm
   geom_col(position = "stack", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.75) +
   scale_fill_manual(values = fate_cols, name = "OTU fate") +
   scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
   coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
   labs(x = "Date", y = "Relative abundance (%)") +
   theme_wali())

# Save plot
saveRDS(p_fate_bar, file.path(output_path, "../figure_7_s18_taxa_response/components/A_otu_fates_bar.rds"))

# ---- Fate dot plot (coloured by fate) ----

(p_fate_dot <- ggplot(dot_data %>%
                        mutate(grp = if_else(Fate == "Persistent baseline", "base", "other")) %>%
                        arrange(Fate),                       # Persistent first → drawn behind
                      aes(x = DM, y = Abundance, fill = Fate,
                          alpha = grp, size = grp, colour = grp)) +
   annotate("rect", xmin = 2.5, xmax = 3.5, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, fill = "#dfdfdf") +
   geom_point(shape = 21, stroke = 0.4, position = position_quasirandom(width = 0.4, varwidth = T)) +
   scale_fill_manual(values = fate_cols, name = "OTU fate", limits = fate_order) +

   guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3, colour = "black"))) +
   scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", labels = scales::percent) +
   labs(x = "Date", y = "OTU mean relative abundance") +
   theme_wali())

# Save plot
saveRDS(p_fate_dot, file.path(output_path, "../figure_7_s18_taxa_response/components/B_otu_fates_dot.rds"))

# ---- Archived: rainbow/grey dot plot (coloured by 09 Jul baseline) ----
(p_fate_dot_grey <- ggplot(arrange(dot_data, OTU, DM),
                           aes(x = DM, y = Abundance, colour = log(abund_col))) +
   geom_line(aes(group = OTU), linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.5,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, seed = 3922)) +

ggsave(file.path(output_path, "../figure_6_s18_alpha_beta/previous_versions/s18_grey_dots.pdf"),
       p_fate_dot_grey, device = "pdf", width = 9, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 1000)

# Per-OTU per-date mean (%) and pre-storm baseline
otu_traj <- otu_long %>%
  group_by(OTU, Fate, DM) %>%

baseline_abund <- otu_long %>%
```

**Figure 4C. Relative abundance composition by storm-response fate across the five sampling dates.** Stacked bars give the percentage of total bacterioplankton relative abundance contributed by each OTU fate category (defined in Table 2) on each date. Persistent baseline OTUs (grey) constitute the bulk of the assemblage throughout, while the storm-responsive fates (colored) form minor shares. Gray shading marks the storm day (23 Jul).

**Figure 4D. OTU-level relative abundance by storm-response fate across the five sampling dates.** Each point represents one OTU — restricted to those with mean relative abundance ≥ 0.01% across the assemblage — on a single date, plotted as its mean relative abundance across sampling sites and colored by fate category (defined in Table S#). Persistent baseline OTUs are shown in grey as a backdrop, with the storm-responsive fates colored; points are horizontally jittered within each date to reduce overplotting. Zero values are plotted at a below-detection floor (half the smallest non-zero value) to permit display on the log~10~-transformed y-axis. Gray shading marks the storm day (23 Jul).

**Figure [archived — grey dots]. OTU-level relative abundance trajectories colored by pre-storm baseline abundance.** Each line traces one OTU (mean relative abundance ≥ 0.01% across the assemblage) across the five sampling dates, plotted as its mean relative abundance across sampling sites and colored by the logarithm of its 09 Jul relative abundance (reversed Spectral palette; red = high baseline, blue = low), with OTUs undetected on 09 Jul shown in grey. Points and connecting lines are horizontally jittered to reduce overplotting. The y-axis is log~10~-transformed.

**Figure S5C. OTU-level relative abundance trajectories across storm-response fates:** pre-existing fates (Persistent baseline, Recovered, Storm-displaced; top row, blue facet labels) and novel fates (Storm-introduced, Storm-transient, Post-storm arrival; bottom row, red facet labels). Each thin line represents one OTU, plotted on each date as its mean relative abundance across sampling sites; line intensity encodes pre-storm baseline relative abundance (darker = higher baseline), with novel-fate OTUs — absent pre-storm by definition — shown at the lightest intensity. The bold line in each facet traces the median OTU trajectory. Zero values, including absences intrinsic to a fate category, are plotted at a below-detection floor (half the smallest non-zero value) to permit display on the log~10~-transformed y-axis. Gray shading marks the storm day (23 Jul) throughout.



## Abundance-based resilience 
Investigates how abundances of shared taxa changed (increased, decreased, recovered) with Wilcoxon signed-rank tests.
```{r}
# Write function to calculate percent change
calc_perc_change <- function(pre, comp) { # For pre-storm (pre) and comparison (comp) values
  pre_mean <- mean(pre)
  comp_mean <- mean(comp)
  if (all(pre == 0 & comp == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) { return(0) } # If both vectors are only zeros, return 0
  out <- ((comp_mean - pre_mean)/pre_mean)*100
  return(round(out, 1))
  # Notes:  If the OTU was absent before the storm but present in the comparison, the results will be +Inf (OTU appeared)
  #         If the OTU was present pre-storm but absent in the comparison, the result will be -Inf (OTU dissappeared)
}

# Write function to calculate number of complete comparisons
calc_n <- function(pre, comp) { # For pre-storm (pre) and comparison (comp) values
   idx <- complete.cases(pre, comp) # Identify complete pairs
   pre  <- pre[idx] # Keep only complete pairs
   comp <- comp[idx] # Keep only complete pairs
   stopifnot(length(pre)==length(comp)) # Sanity check
   return(length(comp)) # Return number of comparisons
}

# Write function to run test
calc_wilcox <- function(pre, comp) { # For pre-storm (pre) and comparison (comp) values
    idx <- complete.cases(pre, comp) # Identify complete pairs
    pre  <- pre[idx] # Keep only complete pairs
    comp <- comp[idx] # Keep only complete pairs
    if (all(pre == comp, na.rm = TRUE)) { return(1) } # If both vectors are identical, there was no change so return p = 1
    wilc <- wilcox.test(pre, comp, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE) # Run Wilcox test
    return(wilc$p.value) # Return test statistics
}

# Write function to calculate effect size
calc_effsize <- function(pre, comp) { # For orginal (pre) and comparison (comp) values
  idx <- complete.cases(pre, comp) # Identify complete pairs
  pre  <- pre[idx] # Keep only complete pairs
  comp <- comp[idx] # Keep only complete pairs
  if (all(pre == comp, na.rm = TRUE)) { return(0) } # If both vectors are identical, there was no change so return r = 0
  df_long <- data.frame(value = c(pre, comp), group = factor(rep(c("pre", "comp"), each = length(pre)), levels = c("pre", "comp"))) # Wrangle into dataframe
  out <- wilcox_effsize(df_long, value ~ group, paired = TRUE)
  return(out$effsize[[1]]) # Return effect statistics
}

# Write function to run tests for all otus 
run_wilcox = function(ps) {
  # 1. Filter taxa -----------------------------
  ps_wilcox <- filter_taxa(ps, function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0.01, prune = TRUE) # Abundance filter: Remove taxa with < 1% maximum abundance
  ps_wilcox = filter_taxa(ps_wilcox, function(x) sum(x > 0) >= 5, TRUE) # Prevalence filter: Remove taxa present in < 5 samples (10% of samples)

  # 2. Data wrangling ---------------------------
  tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_wilcox))
  tax$OTU <- rownames(tax)
  tax_table(ps_wilcox) <- tax_table(as.matrix(tax))
  df = merge(as.data.frame(otu_table(t(ps_wilcox))), as.data.frame(sample_data(t(ps_wilcox))), by = 0) # Save as data frame
  
  # 3. Compute site means per Taxon x Site x Stage2 ------------------
  site_means <- df %>%
    group_by(Site, Stage2) %>%
    dplyr::summarise_at(vars(starts_with("Otu")), mean, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Stage2, values_from = starts_with("Otu"))
  
  # 4. Run Wilcoxon Signed Rank Tests ------------------
  otus <- gsub("_Pre$", "", grep("_Pre$", names(site_means), value = TRUE)) # Save vector of OTU names
  res <- data.frame(OTU = otus, # Create empty dataframe to fill
                    perc_diff_pre_v_storm = NA, perc_diff_pre_v_post1w = NA, perc_diff_pre_v_post2w = NA, # d = % difference
                    n_pre_v_storm = NA, n_pre_v_post1w = NA, n_pre_v_post2w = NA, # n = number of comparisons
                    wilcox_p_pre_v_storm = NA, wilcox_p_pre_v_post1w = NA, wilcox_p_pre_v_post2w = NA, # p = p-value
                    wilcox_r_pre_v_storm = NA, wilcox_r_pre_v_post1w = NA, wilcox_r_pre_v_post2w = NA) # r = effect size
                     
  for (i in 1:length(otus)) { # For each OTU
    # Subset data
    pre    <- site_means[[paste0(otus[i], "_Pre")]]    # Save vector of pre-storm data
    storm  <- site_means[[paste0(otus[i], "_Storm")]]  # Save vector of storm data
    post1w <- site_means[[paste0(otus[i], "_Post1w")]] # Save vector of post-storm week 1 data
    post2w <- site_means[[paste0(otus[i], "_Post2w")]] # Save vector of post-storm week 2 data
    
    # Calculate percent difference
    res$perc_diff_pre_v_storm[i]   <- calc_perc_change(pre = pre, comp = storm) # Save percent differences (d)
    res$perc_diff_pre_v_post1w[i]  <- calc_perc_change(pre = pre, comp = post1w)
    res$perc_diff_pre_v_post2w[i]  <- calc_perc_change(pre = pre, comp = post2w)
    
    # Save number of comparisons
    res$n_pre_v_storm[i]           <- calc_n(pre = pre, comp = storm) # Ensure exact matching and save number of comparisons (n)
    res$n_pre_v_post1w[i]          <- calc_n(pre = pre, comp = post1w)
    res$n_pre_v_post2w[i]          <- calc_n(pre = pre, comp = post2w)
    
    # Calculate paired Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Tests
    res$wilcox_p_pre_v_storm[i]    <- calc_wilcox(pre = pre, comp = storm) # Save p-values (p)
    res$wilcox_p_pre_v_post1w[i]   <- calc_wilcox(pre = pre, comp = post1w)
    res$wilcox_p_pre_v_post2w[i]   <- calc_wilcox(pre = pre, comp = post2w)
    
    # Calculate paired Wilcoxon effect sizes
    res$wilcox_r_pre_v_storm[i]    <- calc_effsize(pre = pre, comp = storm) # Save effect sizes (r)
    res$wilcox_r_pre_v_post1w[i]   <- calc_effsize(pre = pre, comp = post1w)
    res$wilcox_r_pre_v_post2w[i]   <- calc_effsize(pre = pre, comp = post2w)
  }
  
  # 5. P-value adjustment and status categorization  ------------------
  res2 <- res %>% # P-value adjustment and categorization
    mutate(
      wilcox_p_pre_v_storm = round(p.adjust(wilcox_p_pre_v_storm, method = "BH"), 4), # P-value adjustment (Benjamini-Hochberg method)
      wilcox_p_pre_v_post1w  = round(p.adjust(wilcox_p_pre_v_post1w,  method = "BH"), 4),
      wilcox_p_pre_v_post2w  = round(p.adjust(wilcox_p_pre_v_post2w,  method = "BH"), 4),
      wilcox_s_pre_v_storm = symnum(wilcox_p_pre_v_storm, cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1), symbols = c("***", "**", "*", ".","ns")), # Add sign
      wilcox_s_pre_v_post1w = symnum(wilcox_p_pre_v_post1w, cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1), symbols = c("***", "**", "*", ".","ns")),
      wilcox_s_pre_v_post2w = symnum(wilcox_p_pre_v_post2w, cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1), symbols = c("***", "**", "*", ".","ns")),
      status_storm = ifelse(wilcox_p_pre_v_storm <= 0.05, "altered", "recovered"), # Categorize as altered or recovered
      status_post1w  = ifelse(wilcox_p_pre_v_post1w  <= 0.05, "altered", "recovered"),
      status_post2w  = ifelse(wilcox_p_pre_v_post2w  <= 0.05, "altered", "recovered")
    )
  
  # 6. Summarize results  ------------------
  tot = sum(taxa_sums(prune_taxa(res2$OTU, ps)))/sum(taxa_sums(ps))*100 # Save sum of tested otu's total relative abundance
  
  summ_res <- res2 %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total = dplyr::n(),
      altered = sum(status_storm == "altered", na.rm = TRUE),
      recovered_post1w = sum(status_storm == "altered" & status_post1w == "recovered", na.rm = TRUE),
      recovered_post2w = sum(status_storm == "altered" & status_post2w == "recovered", na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      perc_altered = 100 * altered / total,
      perc_recovered_post1w = 100 * recovered_post1w / altered,
      perc_recovered_post2w = 100 * recovered_post2w / altered
    )
  
  # 6. Return results   ------------------
  out = list(res = res2, 
             tot = paste("The total relative abundnace of tested groups is ", round(tot,2), "%.", sep = ""), # Sum of tested otu's total relative abundance
             summ = summ_res)
  return(out)
}

# wilcox_OTU <- run_wilcox(ps = ps_rel) # Run tests at the OTU level
ps_rel_genus = tax_glom(ps_rel, taxrank="Genus")
wilcox_genera <- run_wilcox(ps = ps_rel_genus) # Run tests at the genus level
wilcox_genera$tot
wilcox_genera$summ

# Save wilcoxon summary table
(wilcox_df <- wilcox_genera$res[ ,c(
    # Pre v. storm
    "perc_diff_pre_v_storm",  # Percent difference
    "wilcox_r_pre_v_storm",   # Wilcoxon effect size
    "wilcox_p_pre_v_storm",   # Wilcoxon p-value
    "wilcox_s_pre_v_storm",   # Wilcoxon p-sign
    #  Pre v. post1w
    "perc_diff_pre_v_post1w", # Percent difference
    "wilcox_r_pre_v_post1w",  # Wilcoxon effect size
    "wilcox_p_pre_v_post1w",  # Wilcoxon p-value
    "wilcox_s_pre_v_post1w",  # Wilcoxon p-sign
    # Pre v. post2w
    "perc_diff_pre_v_post2w", # Percent difference
    "wilcox_r_pre_v_post2w",  # Wilcoxon effect size
    "wilcox_p_pre_v_post2w",  # Wilcoxon p-value
    "wilcox_s_pre_v_post2w"   # Wilcoxon p-sign
  )
])


```
**Methods:** Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests were used to assess changes in taxon-specific relative abundances across sampling periods. To evaluate disturbance responses and subsequent recovery relative to baseline conditions, each period was compared directly to the pre-storm period only. This design captures which taxa exhibited significant increases or decreases during the storm and whether their abundances returned toward baseline over time. Only taxa present in both samples within a comparison were included, and p-values were adjusted using the Benjamini–Hochberg procedure.

**Results:** 


## Membership-based resilience
Investigates taxa gains and losses, turnover/replacement, and nestedness.
```{r}
# 2. Tabulate OTU by stage across genera -----------------------------
ps_pa <- transform_sample_counts(ps_rel, function(x) { 
  x[x > 0] <- 1 # Transform relative abundace to presence/absence
  return(x)
})

otu_tax <- tax_table(ps_pa) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Otu") %>%
  select(Otu, Division, Class, Family, Genus) 

otu_meta <- sample_data(ps_pa) %>%
  data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("SampleID")

otu_counts <- t(otu_table(ps_pa)) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>% 
  left_join(otu_meta[,c("SampleID", "Stage2")], by = "SampleID") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Otu"),    # OTU abundance columns
    names_to = "Otu",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Abundance = as.numeric(Abundance))


otu_summ <- otu_counts %>%
  left_join(otu_tax, by = "Otu") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Stage2, Division, Class, Family, Genus) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(observed = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%                     # drop grouping
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Stage2,           # columns = stages
    values_from = observed,         # fill with observed counts
    values_fill = 0,                # 0 if never observed in that stage
    names_glue  = "no_otus_{Stage2}"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    no_otus_total = rowSums(across(starts_with("no_otus_"))))
```


## Membership turnover
Captures presence/absence-based gain/loss between dates; can partition into “replacement” vs “nestedness” (Baselga 2010)
Ignores abundance weighting (so minor OTUs count equally)
How many OTUs disappeared and how many new ones appeared after the storm?
```{r}
# Convert to presence/absence matrix
ps_pa <- filter_taxa(ps_rel, function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 1e-4, prune = TRUE)  # >0.01%

# Prevalence filter
ps_pa <- filter_taxa(ps_pa, function(x) sum(x > 0) >= 3, TRUE) # Remove OTUs not present in at least 3 samples
  
ps_pa <- transform_sample_counts(ps_pa, function(x) ifelse(x > 0, 1, 0))
otu_pa <- as.data.frame(t(otu_table(ps_pa)))

# Calculate pairwise beta diversity (Jaccard)
beta_pair <- betapart::beta.pair(otu_pa, index.family = "jaccard")

# Components:
# beta_pair$beta.jtu = turnover component (species replacement)
# beta_pair$beta.jne = nestedness component (gain/loss asymmetry)
# beta_pair$beta.jac = total Jaccard dissimilarity

# Make presence/absence by Date_group
df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_pa))

grouped_pa <- otu_pa %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%    # make sample names a column
  left_join(
    sample_data(ps_pa) %>%
      data.frame() %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID"),   # same here for metadata
    by = "SampleID"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Stage2) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ as.numeric(any(. > 0))))

# Now each Date_group (Pre, Storm, etc.) is one row
grouped_pa_mat <- as.data.frame(grouped_pa[,-1])
rownames(grouped_pa_mat) <- grouped_pa$Stage2

# Compute pairwise dissimilarities between timepoints
beta_groups <- betapart::beta.pair(t(grouped_pa_mat), index.family = "jaccard")

# Example: compute pairwise dissimilarity between Pre vs each timepoint
pre_ids    <- rownames(df[df$Stage2 == "Pre", ])
storm_ids  <- rownames(df[df$Stage2 == "Storm", ])
post1_ids  <- rownames(df[df$Stage2 == "Post1w", ])
post2_ids  <- rownames(df[df$Stage2 == "Post2w", ])

(res <- data.frame(
  Comparison = c("Pre-Storm", "Pre-Post_1wk", "Pre-Post_2wk"),
  # Total Jaccard dissimilarity (overall compositional difference)
  Beta_total = c(
    mean(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jac)[pre_ids, storm_ids]),
    mean(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jac)[pre_ids, post1_ids]),
    mean(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jac)[pre_ids, post2_ids])
  ),
  # Turnover component (taxa replaced)
  Beta_jtu = c(
    mean(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jtu)[pre_ids, storm_ids]),
    mean(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jtu)[pre_ids, post1_ids]),
    mean(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jtu)[pre_ids, post2_ids])
  ),
  # Nestedness component (taxa lost/gained without replacement)
  Beta_jne = c(
    mean(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jne)[pre_ids, storm_ids]),
    mean(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jne)[pre_ids, post1_ids]),
    mean(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jne)[pre_ids, post2_ids])
  )
))

# Save total Jaccard dissimilarity
jac_df = rbind(
  data.frame(Group = "Pre-Storm", Value = as.vector(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jac)[pre_ids, storm_ids])),
  data.frame(Group = "Pre-Post_1wk", Value = as.vector(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jac)[pre_ids, post1_ids])),
  data.frame(Group = "Pre-Post_2wk", Value = as.vector(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jac)[pre_ids, post2_ids])))
jac_df$Group = factor(jac_df$Group, levels = c("Pre-Storm", "Pre-Post_1wk", "Pre-Post_2wk"))

# Save turnover component (taxa replaced)
jtu_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(Group = "Pre-Storm", Value = as.vector(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jtu)[pre_ids, storm_ids])),
  data.frame(Group = "Pre-Post_1wk", Value = as.vector(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jtu)[pre_ids, post1_ids])),
  data.frame(Group = "Pre-Post_2wk", Value = as.vector(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jtu)[pre_ids, post2_ids])))
jtu_df$Group = factor(jtu_df$Group, levels = c("Pre-Storm", "Pre-Post_1wk", "Pre-Post_2wk"))

# Save nestedness component (taxa lost/gained without replacement)
jne_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(Group = "Pre-Storm", Value = as.vector(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jne)[pre_ids, storm_ids])),
  data.frame(Group = "Pre-Post_1wk", Value = as.vector(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jne)[pre_ids, post1_ids])),
  data.frame(Group = "Pre-Post_2wk", Value = as.vector(as.matrix(beta_pair$beta.jne)[pre_ids, post2_ids])))
jne_df$Group = factor(jne_df$Group, levels = c("Pre-Storm", "Pre-Post_1wk", "Pre-Post_2wk"))

# ---- Kruskal-Wallis ----
Values <- c("Total Jaccard","Turnover","Nestedness")
kw_jac <- jac_df %>% kruskal_test(Value ~ Group)
kw_jtu <- jtu_df %>% kruskal_test(Value ~ Group)
kw_jne <- jne_df %>% kruskal_test(Value ~ Group)
(jac_kw_tab <- cbind(Values, rbind(kw_jac, kw_jtu, kw_jne)))

# ---- Dunn post-hoc with BH adjustment, plus bracket positions ----
dunn_jac <- jac_df %>%
  dunn_test(Value ~ Group, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "Group", step.increase = 0.10)
dunn_jtu <- jtu_df %>%
  dunn_test(Value ~ Group, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "Group", step.increase = 0.10)
dunn_jne <- jne_df %>%
  dunn_test(Value ~ Group, p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "Group", step.increase = 0.10)

# Function to plot
plot_jac <- function(df, dunn, title, y_pos) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Group, y = Value)) +
    geom_rect(xmin = 1 - 0.5, xmax = 1 + 0.5,
              ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#dfdfdf") +
    stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width = 0.5, lwd = 0.5) +
    geom_boxplot(notch = FALSE, width = 0.5, lwd = 0.5) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(dunn, label = "p.adj.signif",
                       y.position = y_pos,                # <- pass as vector
                       tip.length = 0.025, hide.ns = TRUE,
                       bracket.size = 0.4) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.2),
                       breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    labs(x = "Comparison", y = title) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Pre-Storm" = "Pre–23 Jul",
                                "Pre-Post_1wk" = "Pre–30 Jul",
                                "Pre-Post_2wk" = "Pre–06 Aug")) +
    theme_wali()
}

# Plot
(jac_plot <- ggarrange(
  plot_jac(jac_df, dunn_jac,
           expression(paste("Jaccard Dissimilarity (", italic(beta)[jac], ")")),
           y_pos = c(1, 1.08)) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank()),
  plot_jac(jtu_df, dunn_jtu,
           expression(paste("Turnover (", italic(beta)[jtu], ")")),
           y_pos = c(1, 1.08, 1.16)),
  plot_jac(jne_df, dunn_jne,
           expression(paste("Nestedness (", italic(beta)[jne], ")")),
           y_pos = c(0.7, 0.78)) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank()),
  ncol = 3, nrow = 1, align = "hv"
))

# ---- Save ggplot objects ----
saveRDS(jac_plot, file.path(output_path, "../figure_supp6_18S_mechanisms/components/B_jaccard_dissim.rds"))
```
**Figure S5B. Pre-storm-to-storm and pre-storm-to-post-storm β-diversity of the bacterioplankton community, partitioned into turnover and nestedness, at Heʻeia Fishpond, July–August 2014.** Pairwise Jaccard dissimilarity between each pre-storm sample (09, 16 Jul) and each sample collected on the storm day (Pre–23 Jul; Tropical Storm Wali) or a post-storm date (Pre–30 Jul, Pre–06 Aug), partitioned following Baselga's framework into total Jaccard dissimilarity (β~jac~; left), its turnover component (β~jtu~; center), and its nestedness-resultant component (β~jne~; right). Boxplots show median, interquartile range, and 1.5×IQR whiskers, with points beyond the whiskers shown individually (n = [confirm] pairwise comparisons per group). Gray shading marks the storm-day comparison (Pre–23 Jul). Brackets denote differences between comparison groups (pairwise Wilcoxon rank-sum tests, Benjamini–Hochberg adjusted): * p ≤ 0.05, ** p ≤ 0.01, *** p ≤ 0.001, **** p ≤ 0.0001; non-significant comparisons not shown.


## Tabulate introduced OTUs
```{r}
# 1. Summarize OTUs by stage -----------------------------
# Subset by date group
pre_dates  <- c("09 Jul", "16 Jul")
storm_date <- c("23 Jul")
post1_date <- c("30 Jul")
post2_date <- c("06 Aug")
ps_pre   <- subset_samples(ps_rel,  sample_data(ps_rel)[["DM"]] %in% pre_dates)
ps_storm <- subset_samples(ps_rel,  sample_data(ps_rel)[["DM"]] %in% storm_date)
ps_p1    <- subset_samples(ps_rel,  sample_data(ps_rel)[["DM"]] %in% post1_date)
ps_p2    <- subset_samples(ps_rel,  sample_data(ps_rel)[["DM"]] %in% post2_date)

# Extract names of OTUs detected above threshold in each date group
thresh = 0 # detection threshold (0 = any presence; use >=1 for counts)
pre_set   <- names(which(taxa_sums(ps_pre)   > thresh))
storm_set <- names(which(taxa_sums(ps_storm) > thresh))
p1_set    <- names(which(taxa_sums(ps_p1)    > thresh))
p2_set    <- names(which(taxa_sums(ps_p2)    > thresh))
  
# Calculate the number of OTUs introduced during Storm Wali (i.e., not previously present)
alloch   <- setdiff(storm_set, pre_set) # "allochthonous" = present in storm but absent pre-storm
n_alloch <- length(alloch)

# Persistence
n_alloch_p1    <- sum(alloch %in% p1_set) # Calculate the number of storm-introduced OTUs still present one week later
n_alloch_p2    <- sum(alloch %in% p2_set) # Calculate the number of storm-introduced OTUs still present two weeks later

# Calculate total relative abundance of storm-introduced taxa
ps_alloch_storm <- prune_taxa(alloch, subset_samples(ps_rel, DM == storm_date)) # Prune to storm-introduced taxa in storm samples
storm_rel_abund <- sample_sums(ps_alloch_storm) # Sum across taxa for each sample

ps_alloch_p1 <- prune_taxa(alloch, subset_samples(ps_rel, DM == post1_date)) # Prune to storm-introduced taxa in post week 1 samples
p1_rel_abund <- sample_sums(ps_alloch_p1) # Sum across taxa for each sample

ps_alloch_p2 <- prune_taxa(alloch, subset_samples(ps_rel, DM == post2_date)) # Prune to storm-introduced taxa in post week 1 samples
p2_rel_abund <- sample_sums(ps_alloch_p2) # Sum across taxa for each sample

# Calculate mean and sd of storm-introduced relative abundances
ps_alloch_total <- prune_taxa(alloch, ps_rel) # Prune total data set to storm-introduced taxa
total_rel_abund <- sample_sums(ps_alloch_total) # Sum across taxa for each sample

# Print results
## No of storm-introduced OTUs in the whole dataset
print(paste(round(n_alloch / ntaxa(ps_rel)*100,2), "% of all pond OTUs appeared only during the storm, representing",
            round(sum(total_rel_abund)/sum(sample_sums(ps_rel))*100,2), "% of the total dataset releative abundance"))

## No of OTUs present in storm assemblages
print(paste(round(n_alloch / length(storm_set)*100,2),"% of storm OTUs were newly introduced (absent before the storm), representing a mean relative abundance of", round(mean(storm_rel_abund)*100,2), "±", round(sd(storm_rel_abund)*100,2),"% of storm assemblages")) 

## No of OTUs present one week later
print(paste("Storm-introduced OTUs made up",round(n_alloch_p1 / length(p1_set)*100, 2),"% of OTUs present one week later, representing a mean relative abundance of", round(mean(p1_rel_abund)*100,2), "±", round(sd(p1_rel_abund)*100,2),"% of 1 week post storm assemblages"))

## No of OTUs present two weeks later
print(paste("Storm-introduced OTUs made up",round(n_alloch_p2 / length(p2_set)*100, 2),"% of OTUs present two weeks later, representing a mean relative abundance of", round(mean(p2_rel_abund)*100,2), "±", round(sd(p2_rel_abund)*100,2),"% of 2 week post storm assemblages"))  

```

## Species Indicator Analysis
```{r}
# --- Agglomerate to genus and filter to classified ---
ps_genus <- tax_glom(ps_rel, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = TRUE)
genus_strings <- as.character(tax_table(ps_genus)[, "Genus"])
classified <- !grepl(
  "unclassified|uncultured|Unclassified Eukaryote|\\(F\\)|\\(O\\)|\\(C\\)|\\(P\\)",
  genus_strings,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)
ps_genus <- prune_taxa(classified, ps_genus)

# --- Run multi-level pattern analysis ---
# Genera as rows, samples as columns
otu_classified <- as(otu_table(ps_genus), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_genus)) otu_classified <- t(otu_classified)

# multipatt expects samples as rows
otu_for_indval <- t(otu_classified)

# Sample metadata aligned to OTU columns
samp <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_genus))

# Reproducible permutations
set.seed(127)

# Generalized IndVal; single dates AND date combinations
indval <- multipatt(
  otu_for_indval,
  cluster = as.character(samp$DM),
  func    = "IndVal.g",
  duleg   = FALSE,
  control = how(nperm = 999)
)

# --- Significance + strength filter ---
sig_indicators <- indval$sign %>%
  rownames_to_column("TaxonID") %>%
  mutate(q.value = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  filter(stat > 0.7, p.value < 0.05, q.value < 0.05)

# --- A (specificity) and B (fidelity) for each winning combo, via $sign$index ---
sig_indicators <- sig_indicators %>%
  mutate(
    A = mapply(function(g, i) indval$A[g, i], TaxonID, index),
    B = mapply(function(g, i) indval$B[g, i], TaxonID, index)
  )

# --- Parse "Indicator group" string from binary s.<group> columns ---
group_cols  <- grep("^s\\.", colnames(sig_indicators), value = TRUE)
group_names <- sub("^s\\.", "", group_cols)

sig_indicators <- sig_indicators %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    `Indicator group` = paste(
      group_names[c_across(all_of(group_cols)) == 1],
      collapse = " + "
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- Mean RA (%) within indicator-group samples ---
relabund_scale <- if (max(otu_classified, na.rm = TRUE) > 1.5) 1 else 100

otu_long <- as.data.frame(otu_classified) %>%
  rownames_to_column("TaxonID") %>%
  pivot_longer(-TaxonID, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "abund") %>%
  left_join(
    tibble(Sample = rownames(samp), DM = as.character(samp$DM)),
    by = "Sample"
  )

group_lookup <- sig_indicators %>%
  select(TaxonID, `Indicator group`) %>%
  mutate(DM = strsplit(`Indicator group`, " \\+ ")) %>%
  unnest(DM)

mean_ra <- otu_long %>%
  inner_join(group_lookup, by = c("TaxonID", "DM")) %>%
  group_by(TaxonID, `Indicator group`) %>%
  summarise(`Mean RA (%)` = mean(abund) * relabund_scale, .groups = "drop")

# --- Taxonomy (TaxonID = phyloseq taxa name; Genus is a column in tax_table) ---
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_genus)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("TaxonID") %>%
  select(TaxonID, Division, Family, Genus)

# --- Significance-only set (for tabulation; no IndVal/A/B/RA filters) ---
indval_all <- indval$sign %>%
  rownames_to_column("TaxonID") %>%
  mutate(q.value = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"))   # FDR over ALL tested genera

# Universe actually entered into multipatt
n_genera_tested <- nrow(indval_all)            # == ntaxa(ps_genus) unless any all-zero genera dropped

# Significant date indicators (significance only)
sig_only <- indval_all %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05, q.value < 0.05)
n_sig_genera <- nrow(sig_only)

# Attach the winning indicator-group label (single date or date-combination)
group_cols  <- grep("^s\\.", colnames(sig_only), value = TRUE)
group_names <- sub("^s\\.", "", group_cols)
sig_only <- sig_only %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(`Indicator group` = paste(
    group_names[c_across(all_of(group_cols)) == 1], collapse = " + "
  )) %>%
  ungroup()

# (a) indicators per winning group (single dates AND combinations)
indicators_by_group <- sig_only %>%
  count(`Indicator group`, name = "n_indicator_genera") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_indicator_genera))

# (b) indicators attributable to each single date (counts a genus toward
#     every date appearing in its winning combination)
indicators_by_date <- tibble(DM = group_names) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(n_indicator_genera = sum(sig_only[[paste0("s.", DM)]] == 1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(n_indicator_genera))

message(paste("The number of genera tested was", n_genera_tested))
message(paste("The number of significant indicator genera was ",n_sig_genera))
indicators_by_group
indicators_by_date

# --- Final assembly ---
(sia_tab <- sig_indicators %>%
  left_join(tax_df, by = "TaxonID") %>%
  left_join(mean_ra, by = c("TaxonID", "Indicator group")) %>%
  transmute(
    Division, Family, Genus,
    `Indicator group`,
    A      = round(A, 3),
    B      = round(B, 3),
    IndVal = round(stat, 3),
    `p-value` = signif(q.value, 3),
    `Mean RA (%)` = round(`Mean RA (%)`, 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(`Indicator group`, desc(IndVal)))

sia_tab_filt <- sia_tab %>%
  filter(A >= 0.8, B >= 0.7, `Mean RA (%)` >= 0.6)

# --- Export ---
write.csv(
  sia_tab_filt,
  file.path(output_path, "s18_species_indicators_genera.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

sia_tab_filt
```
